title: Extreme perpetual basis and forward crash risk
research_question: Do extreme perpetual-futures basis observations predict higher subsequent crash incidence and greater downside-tail severity over 7–28 calendar days?

feature_definition.basis: 100 * (perpetual mark price / contemporaneous underlying spot/index price - 1)
feature_definition.daily_aggregation: Median of valid timestamp-aligned basis observations in each UTC day; record matching policy and coverage.
feature_definition.feature_at_t: Median of the last A completed daily basis aggregates; no observation after formation timestamp may enter.
feature_definition.threshold_at_t: Empirical quantile estimated strictly from preceding L completed daily feature values, excluding the current formation-day feature.
feature_definition.absolute_extreme: abs(feature_t) > rolling_quantile(q, L) of abs(feature) over preceding L observations

grid.minimum_history_rule: Require the full rolling_reference_days count of valid prior daily observations; never shorten a window or substitute a threshold.

outcomes.formation_reference: Underlying spot/index close at formation UTC daily close t.
outcomes.forward_path_loss: MAE_h = min(spot/index low from t+1 through t+h) / spot/index close at t - 1.
outcomes.fixed_crash_definition: Crash_kpct is 1 when MAE_h <= -k/100, for k in {10,15,20}.
outcomes.volatility_scaled_definition: Use prior-only standard deviation of the 30 valid daily log returns ending at t-1; sigma_h = sigma_30 * sqrt(h); a k-sigma crash means MAE_h/sigma_h <= -k, k in {2,3,4}.
outcomes.severity_definition: Mean forward MAE and expected shortfall of MAE in the worst 5% of observations; more negative means greater downside severity.
outcomes.no_lookahead: Signals use only completed UTC day t. Outcome lows/closes begin t+1. Require the full horizon.

chronological_splits.split_method: Boundaries use unique UTC dates and source coverage before forward outcomes are calculated. Keep chronological and apply an embargo of 28 full days at every split boundary.
chronological_splits.validation: Frozen primary anchor only; no parameter changes after viewing outcomes.
chronological_splits.historical_holdout: Frozen anchor only; never run the grid or threshold search here.
chronological_splits.live_forward: After preregistration, freeze the latest fully closed UTC cutoff; assess only the primary anchor after full 7/14/28-day horizons close. Do not call it independent if outcomes were previously inspected.

primary_inference.comparison: Within-asset, calendar-week-aware standardized event risk versus non-extreme observations; include asset and calendar-week fixed effects where estimable.
primary_inference.multiplicity: Holm correction across the two anchor co-primary endpoints separately in validation, historical holdout and each genuinely sealed forward block.
primary_inference.temporal_dependence: Moving-block bootstrap over jointly sampled calendar blocks of 56 days, preserving all assets within each selected block; sensitivity uses 28- and 84-day blocks.
primary_inference.controls_policy: Covariates must be known at formation t. Report availability and missingness; no forward fill.

grid_inference.correction: Holm correction across all 2,592 grid cell-endpoint tests for the one registered inferential procedure. Effect sizes and intervals remain reported irrespective of significance.

universe.discovery_order: descending latest publicly available market capitalization rank
universe.historical_membership_rule: At each formation date use a point-in-time historical market-cap rank/rank universe if a free reliable history exists; otherwise retain the asset as a labelled candidate or coverage cohort, never claim it is PIT-eligible.
